title: factdiff.py detect checks a pinned source's repository for availability, one request per repository, so a deleted or private repository is reported gone
goal: factdiff.py detect, census.py check and the lookup revalidation ask, for the pinned sources of a selection, whether each pinned repository still answers (one request per repository and run, through the provider's own route: the forge API or the raw file of one pinned path, within the GitHub unauthenticated limit), and report every pinned source of a repository that answers 404 as gone with the signal 'repository', instead of 'pinned' with no request; the facts citing them are listed for re-sourcing as dead sources are; the suite tests a planted 404 repository with a stubbed response.

report every pinned source of a repository that answers 404 as gone with the signal 'repository', instead of 'pinned' with no request

gates.question: How many GitHub REST API requests may one run ask for repository availability, given the 60 an hour unauthenticated limit?
options: 50 a run, and stop when the response's remaining count is 5 or less
30 a run, and stop at 5 remaining
No cap beyond the response's remaining count
gates.recommendation: 50 a run, and stop when the response's remaining count is 5 or less
gates.answer: 50 a run, and stop when the response's remaining count is 5 or less

gates.question: A raw file's 404 may be the file or its ref, not the repository: what reports a repository as answering 404?
options: The raw 404 is confirmed once by the forge API; the repository is gone only when that answers 404 too
The raw 404 alone reports the repository
gates.recommendation: The raw 404 is confirmed once by the forge API; the repository is gone only when that answers 404 too
gates.answer: The raw 404 is confirmed once by the forge API; the repository is gone only when that answers 404 too

gates.question: Does a pinned source whose repository answers 404 get a row in the fetch state, as other gone verdicts do?
options: No row: the row's checked_utc would stamp the source confirmed in a pack's freshness stamp
A row with the error, as a gone page gets
gates.recommendation: No row: the row's checked_utc would stamp the source confirmed in a pack's freshness stamp
gates.answer: No row: the row's checked_utc would stamp the source confirmed in a pack's freshness stamp

gates.question: Is the repository check of pinned sources always on in detect, or does it have an opt-out flag?
options: Always on: no flag, one request per repository and run
An opt-out flag on detect that leaves pinned sources at pinned with no request
gates.recommendation: Always on: no flag, one request per repository and run
gates.answer: Always on: no flag, one request per repository and run

notes: Premise (2026-10-11): python3 _tools/factdiff.py detect --no-save --source S105 --source S108 reports pinned with no request; meanwhile https://api.github.com/repos/MicrosoftDocs/memdocs, https://github.com/MicrosoftDocs/memdocs and a raw file pinned at memdocs@4b5429df answer 404. Of the 118 kb/public/_sources.csv rows in that repository, 114 were already superseded by Learn pages in earlier censuses and 4 are live (S2196, S-pcy7cqea, S-rgpijsmb, S-yuwxbqz3), so the gap this closes is the next repository that disappears before a census re-sources it. The 4 live rows are the bug filed beside this story. Planned 2026-10-12: premise reproduced (factdiff.py detect --no-save --source S105 --source S108 prints pinned=2 with no request). The lookup revalidation does not exist yet: it lands in ST-mq7we5r2, which runs after this story in the sprint and calls the same detection.
